ci_support_linux_64_python3.11.____cpyth:
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '15'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
cxx_compiler:
- gxx
cxx_compiler_version:
- '15'
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.11.* *_cpython
target_platform:
- linux-64
zip_keys:
- - c_compiler_version
  - cxx_compiler_version
- - python
  - channel_sources

raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "compas_cgal" %}
{% set version = "0.10.0" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/compas-dev/{{ name }}/archive/v{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: e8377e9431398dfdb8731fbe36613008be070a2b550fda6c49b2ea1d2c2c1361

build:
  number: 1

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ stdlib("c") }}
    - {{ compiler("c") }}
    - {{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - cmake
    - make  # [not win]
    - ninja  # [win]
    - cross-python_{{ target_platform }}  # [build_platform != target_platform]
    - python                              # [build_platform != target_platform]
    - nanobind >=1.3.2
    - scikit-build-core[pyproject] >=0.10
  host:
    - pip
    - python
    - nanobind >=1.3.2
    - scikit-build-core[pyproject] >=0.10
  run:
    - python
    - compas
    - numpy

test:
  imports:
    - compas_cgal
  requires:
    - pytest

about:
  home: https://github.com/compas-dev/compas_cgal
  license: LGPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: COMPAS friendly wrappers for CGAL algorithms.
  dev_url: https://github.com/compas-dev/compas_cgal
  doc_url: https://github.com/compas-dev/compas_cgal

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - tomvanmele
    - gonzalocasas
    - petrasvestartas

about.summary: COMPAS friendly wrappers for CGAL algorithms.
